[SWS_DM_00340] Waiting for Stop confirmation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04168
⌈
After having called
apext::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProto-
colHandler::Stop
method of any UDS Transport Protocol implementation, it shall
wait for the corresponding
apext::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportPro-
tocolMgr::HandlerStopped
callback with the related
handlerId
, before it finally
terminates the process.
⌋
7.1.1.2 UDS message reception on a UDS TransportLayer
